title: Harvey Ball (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Harvey Ball applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Harvey Ball (BtnHarveyBall) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Harvey Ball state cycle and persistence codec are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The 0 -> 0.25 -> 0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1.0 -> 0 click cycle snaps off-ladder values onto the ladder, and the AlternativeText state codec round-trips every ladder value culture-independently while still reading legacy culture-formatted states (e.g. de-DE 'oPE_HarveyBall|0,25'); malformed or foreign states are rejected.

scenarios.title: Harvey Ball creates exactly one shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Harvey Ball at 50 percent on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
